settings.rateUnavailable: Exchange rate unavailable — showing amounts in BRL

footer: Fully local processing — no receipt ever leaves your browser.

warnings.barcode-mismatch: The barcode does not match the amount on the receipt. Likely a reading error.
warnings.barcode-unverified: The barcode could not be validated. Double-check the reference.
warnings.date-mismatch: The date read does not match the one embedded in the Pix transaction ID.
warnings.low-confidence: Few fields were recognised. Check everything before exporting.
warnings.duplicate: This entry already exists in the spreadsheet.
warnings.possible-duplicate: The spreadsheet already has an entry with the same date and amount. Check before confirming.

upload.title: Receipts become a spreadsheet.
upload.description: Drop your Pix, wire transfer or boleto receipts below. Fields are extracted on your machine, you review what was read and export the spreadsheet. No file is uploaded anywhere.
upload.dropDescription: or click to browse — PDF, PNG, JPG or WEBP
upload.step1Text: Bank PDF or a photo/screenshot. Several at once.
upload.step2Text: Pix, wire transfers and boletos are detected automatically.
upload.step3Text: Review what was read and export as .xlsx or .csv.

review.title: Review and export
review.description: Check the extracted fields and fix anything you need before generating the spreadsheet.
review.tableHint: Highlighted cells are empty. Click any field to edit, or the eye to see the original receipt.
review.addMoreDescription: Drag or click — they join the same spreadsheet

history.title: Recent spreadsheets
history.description: The last 3 exports are stored in this browser and can be downloaded again in any format.
history.emptyDescription: Once you export, it shows up here.

preview.title: Original receipt
preview.unsupported: Preview is not available for this format.
preview.empty: No text was extracted from this file.

fill.dropTitle: Drop the spreadsheet you already use
fill.dropDescription: .xlsx file — it comes back with the new rows and nothing else changed
fill.columnsHint: Choose what fills each column. Anything you skip stays untouched.
fill.formulaColumn: has a formula — will not be touched
fill.noRows: Review the receipts before filling the spreadsheet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: An overview of the receipts and statements you uploaded, ready to export as PDF.

identity.title: Who you are in these documents
identity.hint: Type the tax ID and the company name to filter the parties found in the documents. The tax ID is checked even when it comes masked.
identity.pick: Tick the parties that are you. Those matching your tax ID are already ticked.
identity.unresolved: {count} left out (you are not a party)
identity.pickFiltered: These are the parties matching what you entered. Tick the ones that are yours.

kpi.skipped: {count} row(s) with no direction were left out of the charts.

flow.title: Money in and out over time
flow.hint: Bars above the line are money in, below are money out.

toggles.hint: Pick what goes into the PDF.

accounts.hint: Money in minus money out for each account you marked as yours.
